versions.content: Float Literals INF , NaN In order to maintain consistency with Float , formula expressions also supports the special float literals INF and NaN . The support of these literals is in particular: – INF is allowed only in the context of operators "==" , "!=" , unary "-" , result of condExpr – NaN is allowed only in the context of operators "==" , "!=" , result of cond- Expr – INF , NaN can only be obtained by literal specification (e.g. in a SwSystem- constValue ) but not as the result of an arithmetic operation (In particular [TPS_GST_00014] is not affected by these literals).
